narr: A cold front moved across western Iowa which had observed unseasonably warm temperatures in the past couple of days. The front set off a line of storms that produced strong wind gusts and smaller hail. The strongest measured wind gust was 68 mph in Page County. A flash flood was also reported in Pottawattamie County.
ev: Emergency manager reported water over the intersection of 33rd Street and 3rd Avenue.
lsr: WATER OVER THE INTERSECTION OF 33RD ST AND 3RD AVE.
